transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, I just don't care about anything anymore. I've completely stopped doing the things I used to like. Not my art classes, or board-game nights, or hiking... I don't even care about getting back to my soccer team. I mostly just sit in my room while everything slips away.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It's been going on since shortly after my divorce. So, it's been about a year and 11 months now.
Have you ever had periods of time where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, elated, or full of energy with much less need for sleep?

No... I haven't ever experienced anything like that. I don't think I've ever had a time where I felt super energetic or like I didn't need much sleep. If anything, it's really just been the exact opposite. I just feel heavy and exhausted all the time.
Before this started around the time of your divorce, had you ever gone through another period in your life where you felt depressed or lost interest like this?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days or felt sad before, just like anyone, but never anything like this. Before my divorce, I was always pretty involved in my life. I never went through a period where I just completely stopped caring about everything. So, no, this is really the first time it's been like this.
During these past nearly two years, have you had any periods where you felt back to your normal self for more than a couple of months at a time?

No... not really. It's been pretty constant. I haven't had any time where I felt like my old self again, definitely not for a couple of months at a stretch. It's just been this same heavy feeling the whole time.
During this time, have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep replaying every little thing I did wrong in my marriage, and even with my friends. It's like I can't stop thinking about all my mistakes. And honestly, part of me really believes that people would just be safer, and less burdened, if I were gone.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns since this started?

Yes, my sleep has been really bad. I... I lie awake for hours at night. I just keep checking the door and listening to make sure no one is there. And then, when I finally do fall asleep, I end up waking up way before dawn. I wake up shaking, and I just can't get back to sleep after that.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your weight during this time?

Yeah, my appetite is pretty much gone. I usually go most of the day without eating... food just tastes like cardboard to me right now, so I don't really bother. I've definitely lost weight, too. My jeans have gotten so loose that I actually have to knot the waistband just to keep them up.

Yeah, I have. It really depends on the day. Sometimes I just... I pace back and forth from the kitchen to the window until my legs actually ache. But then other times, I move so slowly. Just doing something simple, like trying to make a cup of coffee, feels like I'm lifting wet cement.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't see or hear?

Yes, I do. I... I hear a woman's voice. It comes from the corner of my room. She tells me that I ruined everything, and that I should just stay inside. It isn't just a thought, either... it sounds as clear as if someone were standing right next to my bed talking to me.
